title: In Praise of My Typewriter
summary: The A.I. projects editor at The New York Times uses chatbots every day. But when it’s time to write, he reaches for an Olivetti Lettera 22 from the 1950s.

title: Can Roof Tiles Reduce Indoor Heat? India Is Finding Out.
summary: As temperatures soar, researchers are experimenting with ways to make life more comfortable for the most vulnerable.
caption: Workers installing heat-reflective tiles on a house in the Kanchipuram district on the outskirts of Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

title: A Japanese Volleyball Player Breaks a Taboo
summary: Rui Takahashi, 26, has made waves as one of only a few professional athletes to come out as gay in Japan.
authors: Javier C. Hernández and Hisako Ueno

title: The Threat to a Sanctuary for Children of North Korean Defectors
summary: A school in Seoul caters to students whose parents fled North Korea. Neighbors want it gone, and students say it is just one example of the prejudice they face in the South.
caption: Students running laps with teachers before lunch at Yeomyung School in Seoul in November.
